main.name: Arpit Singh
main.currently: Computer Science Student at the University of Toronto
main.bio: I'm a Computer Science student at the University of Toronto with a strong interest in software engineering, machine learning, and data-driven problem solving. My background spans computational research (stellar astrophysics at the Dunlap Institute), independent software development (published mobile games, an e-commerce platform), and applied ML projects like an LLM safety system built with PyTorch. I enjoy building full-stack applications and analytical tools that tackle real-world problems, and I'm eager to keep building impactful technology in collaborative, fast-paced environments.
main.contactmessage: Thank you for viewing my portfolio. Feel free to reach out via email or phone.

work.company: Dunlap Institute for Astronomy & Astrophysics, University of Toronto
work.title: Research Intern, Stellar Astrophysics
description: Conducted independent computational research under advisor Dr. Nikki Noughani, configuring and executing MESA stellar-evolution simulations across multiple model parameters.
Built Python workflows (NumPy, Matplotlib, mesa_reader) to process, filter, and transform structured simulation datasets, converting logarithmic outputs into physical quantities.
Documented methodology and findings in a technical research poster and presentation.

work.title: Technical Research Intern
description: Built a Python data-processing pipeline analyzing 10,000+ real and simulated datasets, improving signal-detection accuracy by 10%.
Designed and implemented algorithms for curve fitting and model comparison across 100 experimental conditions, reaching 85% predictive accuracy.
Presented technical methodology and results to a research seminar of 200+ participants.

work.title: Founder & E-commerce Developer
description: Founded and managed an e-commerce store using Shopify with automated product sourcing via AutoDS.
Ran A/B tests on pricing and UX and executed TikTok advertising campaigns, analyzing performance metrics to optimize engagement and conversions.
Gained hands-on experience in analytics, marketing strategy, and online business operations.

work.title: Mobile Game Developer
description: Designed, developed, and published multiple mobile games using Unity and C#.
Reached over 1,000 total downloads with strong user ratings on the Google Play Store.
Profiled and optimized performance and managed monetization strategies across releases.
